description: Java source file for the REST API resource 'DatatablesApiResource' in the Apache Fineract project. The class provides endpoints to manage data tables, including listing, creating, updating, deleting, registering/deregistering tables, as well as CRUD operations for entries within those tables. It handles HTTP methods such as GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE and uses annotations like @Path, @Operation, and @ApiResponse for API documentation. The file interacts with several services for data access, security, and serialization, and is part of the API layer for dynamic data table management.

classes.name: DatatablesApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class providing endpoints for dynamic data table management in Apache Fineract, including CRUD operations for tables and their entries, registration, deregistration, and querying functionalities.

methods.name: getDatatables
methods.description: Lists registered data tables, optionally filtered by application table name.

methods.name: createDatatable
methods.description: Creates a new data table and registers it with an application table.

methods.name: updateDatatable
methods.description: Updates the specified data table's configuration or registration.

methods.name: registerDatatable
methods.description: Registers a data table with an application table, enabling API management.

methods.name: deregisterDatatable
methods.description: Deregisters a data table, making it unavailable through API.

methods.name: getDatatable
methods.description: Retrieves details for a specific registered data table.

methods.name: queryValues
methods.description: Executes a query to retrieve data from a registered data table based on filters.

methods.name: advancedQuery
methods.description: Performs an advanced query with pagination on a data table.

methods.name: getDatatable
methods.description: Retrieves data entries (single or multiple) for a specific data table associated with an application record.

methods.name: getDatatableManyEntry
methods.description: Retrieves multiple entries for a data table linked to an application record.

methods.name: createDatatableEntry
methods.description: Adds a new row to a data table entry for a specific application record.

methods.name: updateDatatableEntryOnetoOne
methods.description: Updates a single row in a data table for a one-to-one relationship.

methods.name: updateDatatableEntryOneToMany
methods.description: Updates a row in a data table for a one-to-many relationship.

methods.name: deleteDatatableEntries
methods.description: Deletes entries (single or multiple) from a data table linked to an application record.

methods.name: deleteDatatableEntry
methods.description: Deletes a specific entry from a data table in a one-to-many relationship.
